image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a custom automotive wheel assembly. The wheel features a five-spoke alloy rim with a two-tone finish: polished silver faces on the spokes and a deep metallic red inner barrel and recessed areas. The center cap displays a yellow shield logo with a black prancing horse (resembling the Ferrari emblem). A black rubber tire is mounted on the rim, showing visible tread blocks on the shoulder and white residue/dust on the sidewall. Through the spokes, a drilled brake rotor and caliper are partially visible in the background.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The white substance on the tire sidewall appears somewhat smeared and lacks the granular texture of real road dust or chalk; it looks slightly like generated noise or smudged paint rather than physical particulate matter.
The edges of the yellow shield logo are slightly soft and bleed into the black background of the center cap, lacking the crisp die-cut edge expected of a metal emblem.

The drilled holes in the brake rotor appear slightly irregular in spacing and shape, suggesting minor geometric inconsistency in the background details, though this could be due to motion blur or depth of field.
